description: Agent-based, networked social-epidemic-market simulation of mask adoption under policy, social influence, information dynamics, supply constraints, and disease transmission.

parameters.health_state: S for all except initial_infected_count set to I
parameters.contacts_network: Watts-Strogatz small_world(k=average_degree, beta=0.1) plus household cliques

modules.name: MobilityAndPresence
modules.description: Assigns daily movement of persons across locations and determines contacts opportunity sets.

notes: Daily schedule types: household overnight; work/school on weekdays; community/retail/transit stochastically.
Contact opportunities per location are later sampled by ContactTransmission using baseline_contact_rate * contact_rate_multiplier_by_location.

modules.name: InformationCampaign
modules.description: Broadcasts information from PolicyMaker and MediaOutlets to persons, updating risk perception, trust, and misinformation flags.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person p:
  trust_decay = trust_decay_rate_without_communication
  p.trust_in_authorities = clip01(p.trust_in_authorities - trust_decay)
  net_campaign = PolicyMaker.campaign_intensity + mean(MediaOutlet.campaign_intensity * MediaOutlet.credibility * sign(MediaOutlet.bias))
  p.trust_in_authorities = clip01(p.trust_in_authorities + trust_boost_per_campaign * net_campaign)
  misinformation_draw = Bernoulli(misinformation_rate * (1 - p.trust_in_authorities) + media_misinformation_probability)
  if misinformation_draw==1:
    p.misinformation_exposure = 1
    p.risk_perception = clip01(p.risk_perception * (1 - 0.2))
  else:
    p.risk_perception = clip01(p.risk_perception + risk_perception_update_rate * (observed_local_prevalence - p.risk_perception))
notes: observed_local_prevalence is computed from recent infections in p's ego-network.

modules.name: MaskMarket
modules.description: Handles mask purchasing, retailer restocking and dynamic pricing.

notes: inventory_threshold default 2 masks; pack_size default 5 for cloth/surgical, 1 for N95.
Price adjustment uses excess demand fraction with damping.

modules.name: MaskAdoptionDecision
modules.description: Agents decide whether to wear a mask and which type, given social influence, risk, policy, prices, and fatigue.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person p:
  norm = mean(mask_use of contacts)  // Neighborhood.mask_use_observed
  policy_presence = is_mandate_active_at(p.current_location_id)
  expected_penalty = policy_presence ? enforcement_probability * penalty_amount : 0
  utility_wear = 1.0 * p.risk_perception + social_influence_weight * norm + p.compliance_propensity * policy_presence + (expected_penalty / penalty_income_scaler)
  disutility_wear = 0.2 + p.adherence_fatigue
  net = utility_wear - disutility_wear
  wear_prob = sigmoid(3 * net - 1)
  decide_wear = Bernoulli(wear_prob)
  if decide_wear:
    p.compliant_today = true
    choose mask_type among available inventory of p, else trigger purchase attempt via MaskMarket
    if no inventory obtained: p.compliant_today = false; p.mask_type = 'none'
  else:
    p.compliant_today = false; p.mask_type = 'none'
  p.adherence_fatigue = clip01(p.adherence_fatigue + adherence_fatigue_rate * (p.compliant_today ? 1 : -0.5))
notes: Expected penalty is normalized by penalty_income_scaler to map currency into utility units.

modules.name: PolicyEnforcement
modules.description: Activates mandates by location type, conducts compliance checks, and issues warnings/penalties.

notes: Warnings can be modeled as zero-penalty actions if desired; here penalties are monetary.

modules.name: ContactTransmission
modules.description: Samples contacts and computes infection transmission probabilities given mask usage and location risk.

notes: Multiple exposures in a day are collapsed to a single E transition.

modules.name: DiseaseProgression
modules.description: Advances disease states S->E->I->R with symptomatic assignment.

notes: Mean-based dwell times; can be replaced with gamma/Erlang draws if desired.
Vaccination_status is unused by default but available for extensions.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates mask adoption and compliance statistics.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate = mean(1 if p.mask_type != 'none' else 0 for p)
compliance_rate_under_mandate = mean(p.compliant_today over persons at locations with mandate active)
adoption_by_group = groupby(demographic_group).mean(mask_type != 'none')
emit observables

modules.name: DiseaseMetricsAggregator
modules.description: Computes daily new infections, Rt, prevalence.

notes: Simple Rt proxy; replace with EpiEstim-style if needed.
Serial interval approximated by incubation mean.

update_rule.pseudocode:
enforcement_actions = sum(actions_today)
stockout_flag = any(min(r.inventory_masks.values()) == 0 for r in retailers)
emit observables
notes: Stockout flagged if any mask type hits zero in any retailer.

modules.name: CostAggregator
modules.description: Tracks cumulative economic cost including purchases, penalties, campaigns, and enforcement.

update_rule.pseudocode:
cost_purchases = sum(today's mask purchase spending)
cost_penalties = sum(penalty_amount per enforcement action)
cost_campaigns = campaign_unit_cost * PolicyMaker.campaign_intensity
cost_enforcement = enforcement_unit_cost * PolicyMaker.enforcement_resources
cumulative_costs += cost_purchases + cost_penalties + cost_campaigns + cost_enforcement
emit costs_total_cumulative
notes: Unit costs configurable; default: campaign_unit_cost=1000 per day intensity unit; enforcement_unit_cost=2 per resource unit.

algorithms.WattsStrogatzNetwork: Small-world graph generator to construct social contacts.
algorithms.EgoNetworkPrevalence: Compute observed local prevalence from ego-network for risk updates.
algorithms.UtilityBasedAdoption: Logit-based decision rule using risk, norms, policy, fatigue, and cost.
algorithms.ContactSampling: Poisson contact sampling per person per location block.
algorithms.TransmissionWithMaskEfficacy: Per-contact Bernoulli with multiplicative mask efficacies.
algorithms.CompartmentProgression: S->E->I->R state machine with mean dwell times.
algorithms.DynamicPricing: Inventory-demand feedback to adjust prices with damping.
algorithms.RtEstimationSimple: Ratio of new infections shifted by serial interval.
